props.name: title
props.description: States the outcome in words — "Payment received", "We couldn't confirm your booking". Required.

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the status mark. Defaults to an English word per status; pass your own to localise.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the status glyph inside the mark. The mark keeps its shape, colour and `statusLabel`.

props.name: media
props.description: Replaces the whole mark — an illustration, a product image. Decorative: the status is still announced through `statusLabel`.

props.name: reference
props.description: Usually a `<ReferenceCode>`: the booking reference, order number or transaction ID the reader will need again.

props.name: primaryAction
props.description: The one thing to do next. Rendered first in reading order.

props.name: align
props.description: `start` for a result inside a wider layout (a panel, a side sheet); `center` (default) for a full screen.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the title. Default 2 — a result inside a page whose own h1 is the app's.

props.name: announce
props.description: Make the title and description a polite live region, for a result that changes in place.
